title: Glowing Effect
description: Border glow that follows the pointer around a card's edge as it comes near.

a11y.motion: The arc stops following the pointer; hovering the card shows a soft glow around the whole border instead.
a11y.keyboard: The effect is not focusable; the full border lights up while the card or anything inside it has keyboard focus.
a11y.screenReader: The glow layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only the card content is read.

examples.name: feature-grid
examples.title: Feature grid
examples.description: Six feature cards in a three-column grid, each lighting up as the pointer nears it.
